text: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation. No marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / lamp electronics (ESA); Housing (marking location)
test_case: Visual inspection of the ESA (rear combination lamp electronics/housing) when approved as an ESA type: R10 approval mark per paragraph 5.3. present. Pass if present; not required where the electronics are approved only as part of a vehicle type.

text: An international approval mark shall be affixed, in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form, on each vehicle conforming to the type approved under this Regulation.
applies_to: Vehicle-level EMC approval marking (vehicle fitted with the rear combination lamp electronics)
test_case: Visual inspection of a production vehicle against the approval communication form: mark present, in the specified location, conspicuous and easily accessible.

text: The international approval mark shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
applies_to: Vehicle-level EMC approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection of the affixed mark: circle with letter "E" present, followed by the distinguishing number of the approving Contracting Party per Annex 3 of R.E.3 (ECE/TRANS/WP.29/78/Rev.6).

text: The international approval mark shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number, to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1.
applies_to: Vehicle-level EMC approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection of the affixed mark: "10R-" followed by the approval number, positioned to the right of the "E" circle, matching the approval communication.

text: Markings on ESAs in conformity with paragraph 5.3. need not be visible when the ESA is installed in the vehicle.
applies_to: Housing / LED modules on PCB (ESA marking)
test_case: Inspection of the ESA marking per paragraph 5.3. on the uninstalled lamp; confirm the marking is present on the ESA. Its visibility when the lamp is installed on the vehicle is not required, so the check passes even if the marking is hidden.

text: The UN R10 approval mark affixed to a vehicle or ESA (Model A or Model B, see paragraph 5.2.) shall have a minimum characteristic dimension a = 6 mm.
applies_to: Approval marking of the ESA (LED modules on PCB / housing)
test_case: Visual inspection and measurement of the affixed approval mark against the Annex 1 Model A/B layouts; pass if dimension a ≥ 6 mm.

text: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB, connector and harness connection of the rear combination lamp (rear position, stop and reversing functions)
test_case: Design review plus vehicle-level and ESA-level EMC testing per UN R10. Pass if the vehicle, with the lamp fitted and operated in normal conditions of use, meets all R10 emission and immunity requirements.

text: A vehicle shall be tested for radiated emissions and for immunity to radiated disturbances; no tests for conducted emissions or immunity to conducted disturbances are required for vehicle type approval.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp as fitted on the M1 vehicle (LED electronics active)
test_case: Vehicle radiated emission test (Annexes 4/5) and radiated immunity test (Annex 6) with the lamp functions operating. Pass if the emissions are within the R10 limits and the lamp functions show no degradation under immunity exposure.

text: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated emissions.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / lamp electronics (ESA)
test_case: ESA broadband and narrowband radiated emission tests per Annexes 7 and 8, with the rear position, stop and reversing functions operating. Pass if the emissions are within the R10 ESA limits.

text: ESA(s) shall be tested for conducted emissions.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB, connector / harness connection (ESA)
test_case: ESA conducted transient emission test on supply lines per Annex 10, with each lamp function switched. Pass if the transients are within the R10 limits.

text: ESA(s) shall be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / lamp electronics (ESA)
test_case: ESA radiated immunity test per Annex 9 (e.g. ALSE, TEM cell, BCI or stripline) at the specified field strength. Pass if the rear position, stop and reversing lamps show no flicker or loss of function beyond the pass/fail criteria in the test plan.

text: ESA(s) shall be tested for immunity to conducted disturbances.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB, connector / harness connection (ESA)
test_case: ESA conducted transient immunity test on supply lines per Annex 10, using the specified test pulses. Pass if the lamp functions meet the required functional status for each pulse.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband type approval limit shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, as shown in Appendix 6.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / lamp electronics (ESA)
test_case: Annex 7 broadband measurement, 30-75 MHz; pass if measured values are below the logarithmically decreasing limit from 62 to 52 dBµV/m (Appendix 6).

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband type approval limit shall be 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz, as shown in Appendix 6.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / lamp electronics (ESA)
test_case: Annex 7 broadband measurement, 75-400 MHz; pass if measured values are below the logarithmically increasing limit from 52 to 63 dBµV/m (Appendix 6).

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband type approval limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / lamp electronics (ESA)
test_case: Annex 7 broadband measurement, 400-1,000 MHz; pass if measured values are below 63 dBµV/m.

text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured broadband emission values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / lamp electronics (ESA)
test_case: Annex 7 broadband measurement over 30-1,000 MHz with each lamp function (rear position, stop, reversing) operating; pass if all measured values are below the limits of paragraph 6.5.2.1.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband type approval limit shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, as shown in Appendix 7.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / lamp electronics (ESA)
test_case: Annex 8 narrowband radiated emission scan 30-75 MHz; pass if emissions are below the limit line falling logarithmically from 52 to 42 dBµV/m (Appendix 7).

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband type approval limit shall be 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz, as shown in Appendix 7.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / lamp electronics (ESA)
test_case: Annex 8 narrowband radiated emission scan 75-400 MHz; pass if emissions are below the limit line rising logarithmically from 42 to 53 dBµV/m (Appendix 7).

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband type approval limit shall remain constant at 53 dB microvolts/m in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / lamp electronics (ESA)
test_case: Annex 8 narrowband radiated emission scan 400-1,000 MHz; pass if emissions are below 53 dBµV/m.

text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured narrowband emission value, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / lamp electronics (ESA)
test_case: Compare Annex 8 narrowband results for the representative lamp, rear position, stop and reversing functions each active, against the paragraph 6.6.2.1 limits over 30-1,000 MHz; pass if all values are below the limits.

text: For ESAs on vehicles with 12 V systems, the maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of transient conducted disturbances emitted on the supply lines shall be +75 V.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB; supply connector (12 V system)
test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 transient emission measurement at 12 V supply, including switching of the rear position, stop and reversing functions; pass if the positive pulse amplitude is ≤ +75 V.

text: For ESAs on vehicles with 12 V systems, the maximum allowed negative pulse amplitude of transient conducted disturbances emitted on the supply lines shall be -100 V.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB; supply connector (12 V system)
test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 transient emission measurement at 12 V supply, including switching of each lamp function; pass if the negative pulse amplitude does not exceed -100 V in magnitude.

text: For ESAs on vehicles with 24 V systems, the maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of transient conducted disturbances emitted on the supply lines shall be +150 V.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB; supply connector (24 V system)
test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 transient emission measurement at 24 V supply, including switching of each lamp function; pass if the positive pulse amplitude is ≤ +150 V.

text: For ESAs on vehicles with 24 V systems, the maximum allowed negative pulse amplitude of transient conducted disturbances emitted on the supply lines shall be -450 V.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB; supply connector (24 V system)
test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 transient emission measurement at 24 V supply, including switching of each lamp function; pass if the negative pulse amplitude does not exceed -450 V in magnitude.

text: When tested by the stripline method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be immune at a test level of 60 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB, wiring harness connection
test_case: Annex 9 stripline test, 20 to 400 MHz at 60 V/m; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions over at least 90 % of the band.

text: When tested by the stripline method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be immune at a minimum test level of 50 V/m over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB, wiring harness connection
test_case: Annex 9 stripline test, 20 to 400 MHz at 50 V/m; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions at any frequency.

text: When tested by the TEM cell method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be immune at a test level of 75 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 200 MHz frequency range.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB
test_case: Annex 9 TEM cell test, 20 to 200 MHz at 75 V/m; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions over at least 90 % of the band.

text: When tested by the TEM cell method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be immune at a minimum test level of 62,5 V/m over the whole 20 to 200 MHz frequency range.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB
test_case: Annex 9 TEM cell test, 20 to 200 MHz at 62,5 V/m; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions at any frequency.

text: When tested by the bulk current injection (BCI) method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be immune at a test level of 60 mA in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.
applies_to: Wiring harness connection, connector, LED driver circuitry on PCB
test_case: Annex 9 BCI test, 20 to 400 MHz at 60 mA injected current; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions over at least 90 % of the band.

text: When tested by the bulk current injection (BCI) method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be immune at a minimum test level of 50 mA over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.
applies_to: Wiring harness connection, connector, LED driver circuitry on PCB
test_case: Annex 9 BCI test, 20 to 400 MHz at 50 mA; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions at any frequency.

text: When tested by the ALSE method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be immune at a test level of 30 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 80 to 2,000 MHz frequency range.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB, wiring harness connection
test_case: Annex 9 ALSE test, 80 to 2,000 MHz at 30 V/m; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions over at least 90 % of the band.

text: When tested by the ALSE method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be immune at a test level of 10 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency range.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB, wiring harness connection
test_case: Annex 9 ALSE test, 2,000 to 6,000 MHz at 10 V/m; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions over at least 90 % of the band.

text: When tested by the ALSE method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be immune at a minimum test level of 25 V/m over the whole 80 to 2,000 MHz frequency range.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB, wiring harness connection
test_case: Annex 9 ALSE test, 80 to 2,000 MHz at 25 V/m; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions at any frequency.

text: When tested by the ALSE method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be immune at a minimum test level of 8 V/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency range.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB, wiring harness connection
test_case: Annex 9 ALSE test, 2,000 to 6,000 MHz at 8 V/m; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions at any frequency.

text: When tested by the reverberation chamber method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be immune at a test level of 21 V/m in over 90 per cent of the LUF to 2,000 MHz frequency range.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB, wiring harness connection
test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber test, LUF to 2,000 MHz at 21 V/m; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions over at least 90 % of the band.

text: When tested by the reverberation chamber method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be immune at a test level of 7 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency range.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB, wiring harness connection
test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber test, 2,000 to 6,000 MHz at 7 V/m; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions over at least 90 % of the band.

text: When tested by the reverberation chamber method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be immune at a minimum test level of 18 V/m over the whole LUF to 2,000 MHz frequency range.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB, wiring harness connection
test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber test, LUF to 2,000 MHz at 18 V/m; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions at any frequency.

text: When tested by the reverberation chamber method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be immune at a minimum test level of 6 V/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency range.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB, wiring harness connection
test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber test, 2,000 to 6,000 MHz at 6 V/m; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions at any frequency.

text: The ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there is no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp functions (LED modules on PCB)
test_case: During all Annex 9 immunity tests, monitor light output of rear position, stop and reversing functions (no unintended switching, flicker, extinguishing or intensity change); pass if no degradation of immunity related functions observed.

text: Starting profile (applicable only to ESAs that could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines started with a 12V/24V starter motor): at immunity test level II for 12 V systems and level II for 24 V systems, 10 pulses, an ESA related to immunity related functions which shall be operational during engine start phases shall achieve functional status B.
applies_to: Stop lamp / rear position lamp functions (immunity related functions), if operational during engine start
test_case: ISO 16750-2 starting profile, level II (12 V), 10 pulses, with lamp functions activated; pass if functional status B per ISO 16750-1 (lamp functions may deviate during test but return to normal automatically afterwards).

text: Starting profile (applicable only to ESAs that could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines started with a 12V/24V starter motor): at immunity test level II for 12 V systems and level II for 24 V systems, 10 pulses, other ESAs related to immunity related functions shall achieve functional status C.
applies_to: Stop lamp / rear position lamp functions (immunity related functions) not required during engine start
test_case: ISO 16750-2 starting profile, level II, 10 pulses; pass if functional status C per ISO 16750-1.

text: Starting profile (applicable only to ESAs that could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines started with a 12V/24V starter motor): at immunity test level II for 12 V systems and level II for 24 V systems, 10 pulses, ESA functions not related to immunity related functions shall achieve functional status D.
applies_to: Reversing lamp / functions not related to immunity related functions
test_case: ISO 16750-2 starting profile, level II, 10 pulses; pass if functional status D per ISO 16750-1.

text: Test pulse 1 at -75 V for 12 V systems (-450 V for 24 V systems), 500 pulses: ESA functions related to immunity related functions shall achieve FPSC III.
applies_to: Stop lamp / rear position lamp (immunity related functions)
test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 1, -75 V (12 V system), 500 pulses; pass if FPSC III per ISO 7637-1.

text: Test pulse 1 at -75 V for 12 V systems (-450 V for 24 V systems), 500 pulses: ESA functions not related to immunity related functions shall achieve FPSC III.
applies_to: Reversing lamp / non-immunity related functions
test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 1, -75 V (12 V system), 500 pulses; pass if FPSC III per ISO 7637-1.

text: Test pulse 2a at +37 V for 12 V systems (+37 V for 24 V systems), 500 pulses: ESA functions related to immunity related functions shall achieve FPSC I.
applies_to: Stop lamp / rear position lamp (immunity related functions)
test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 2a, +37 V, 500 pulses; pass if FPSC I (no deviation of lamp function during and after test).

text: Test pulse 2a at +37 V for 12 V systems (+37 V for 24 V systems), 500 pulses: ESA functions not related to immunity related functions shall achieve FPSC III.
applies_to: Reversing lamp / non-immunity related functions
test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 2a, +37 V, 500 pulses; pass if FPSC III.

text: Test pulse 2b at +10 V for 12 V systems (+20 V for 24 V systems), 10 pulses: ESA functions related to immunity related functions shall achieve FPSC II.
applies_to: Stop lamp / rear position lamp (immunity related functions)
test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 2b, +10 V (12 V system), 10 pulses; pass if FPSC II.

text: Test pulse 2b at +10 V for 12 V systems (+20 V for 24 V systems), 10 pulses: ESA functions not related to immunity related functions shall achieve FPSC III.
applies_to: Reversing lamp / non-immunity related functions
test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 2b, +10 V (12 V system), 10 pulses; pass if FPSC III.

text: Test pulse 3a at -112 V for 12 V systems (-150 V for 24 V systems), test duration 1 h: ESA functions related to immunity related functions shall achieve FPSC I.
applies_to: Stop lamp / rear position lamp (immunity related functions)
test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 3a, -112 V (12 V system), 1 h; pass if FPSC I.

text: Test pulse 3a at -112 V for 12 V systems (-150 V for 24 V systems), test duration 1 h: ESA functions not related to immunity related functions shall achieve FPSC III.
applies_to: Reversing lamp / non-immunity related functions
test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 3a, -112 V (12 V system), 1 h; pass if FPSC III.

text: Test pulse 3b at +75 V for 12 V systems (+150 V for 24 V systems), test duration 1 h: ESA functions related to immunity related functions shall achieve FPSC I.
applies_to: Stop lamp / rear position lamp (immunity related functions)
test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 3b, +75 V (12 V system), 1 h; pass if FPSC I.

text: Test pulse 3b at +75 V for 12 V systems (+150 V for 24 V systems), test duration 1 h: ESA functions not related to immunity related functions shall achieve FPSC III.
applies_to: Reversing lamp / non-immunity related functions
test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 3b, +75 V (12 V system), 1 h; pass if FPSC III.

text: Where a vehicle or electrical/electronic system or ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.3.2. or 6.6.2. and with Annexes 5 and 8.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / LED driver electronics (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions)
test_case: Design review of the PCB schematic and BOM: confirm absence of any oscillator, switching regulator or PWM source with operating frequency > 9 kHz. If confirmed, the narrowband emission tests (para. 6.3.2./6.6.2., Annexes 5 and 8) are waived. Otherwise perform the Annex 8 narrowband test.

text: ESAs with no immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.8. and with Annex 9 to this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (stop, rear position and reversing lamp functions)
test_case: Function analysis of the ESA against the immunity related functions list (e.g. signalling functions such as stop lamp). If no immunity related function is present, Annex 9 radiated immunity testing is waived. Otherwise perform the Annex 9 test with no change of lamp state (stop/position/reversing) under exposure.

text: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission on 12/24 V supply lines and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA power supply / connector to vehicle harness
test_case: Design review of the ESA circuit: confirm the ESA is not switched, contains no switches or contains no inductive load. If confirmed, the Annex 10 transient conducted emission test is waived. Otherwise perform the transient emission test on the 12/24 V supply lines against the limits of para. 6.7.

text: The broadband electromagnetic radiated emissions of the ESA (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.), in the frequency range 30-75 MHz, shall not exceed the limit E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m (F in MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / lamp electronics (ESA broadband emissions)
test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions per the method referenced by paragraph 6.5.2.1./7.10.2.1. (Annex 7 ESA method) with 120 kHz bandwidth, lamp functions (position, stop, reversing) operating; across 30-75 MHz, pass if measured level ≤ 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m at every frequency.

text: The broadband electromagnetic radiated emissions of the ESA (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.), in the frequency range 75-400 MHz, shall not exceed the limit E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m (F in MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / lamp electronics (ESA broadband emissions)
test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions per the method referenced by paragraph 6.5.2.1./7.10.2.1. (Annex 7 ESA method) with 120 kHz bandwidth, lamp functions operating; across 75-400 MHz, pass if measured level ≤ 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m at every frequency.

text: The broadband electromagnetic radiated emissions of the ESA (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.), in the frequency range 400-1,000 MHz, shall not exceed the limit E = 63 dBµV/m for a 120 kHz bandwidth.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / lamp electronics (ESA broadband emissions)
test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions per the method referenced by paragraph 6.5.2.1./7.10.2.1. (Annex 7 ESA method) with 120 kHz bandwidth, lamp functions operating; across 400-1,000 MHz, pass if measured level ≤ 63 dBµV/m at every frequency.

text: For an ESA, the narrowband electromagnetic radiated emission in the frequency range 30-75 MHz shall not exceed the limit E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m (F in MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation).
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / connector (ESA electronics for rear position, stop and reversing functions)
test_case: Narrowband radiated emission measurement of the ESA per paragraph 6.6.2.1. (Annex 8 method), 120 kHz bandwidth, 30-75 MHz, with all lamp functions operating; pass if every measured level is at or below 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

text: For an ESA, the narrowband electromagnetic radiated emission in the frequency range 75-400 MHz shall not exceed the limit E = 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m (F in MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation).
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / connector (ESA electronics for rear position, stop and reversing functions)
test_case: Narrowband radiated emission measurement of the ESA per paragraph 6.6.2.1. (Annex 8 method), 120 kHz bandwidth, 75-400 MHz, with all lamp functions operating; pass if every measured level is at or below 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m.

text: For an ESA, the narrowband electromagnetic radiated emission in the frequency range 400-1,000 MHz shall not exceed the limit E = 53 dBµV/m for a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation).
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / connector (ESA electronics for rear position, stop and reversing functions)
test_case: Narrowband radiated emission measurement of the ESA per paragraph 6.6.2.1. (Annex 8 method), 120 kHz bandwidth, 400-1,000 MHz, with all lamp functions operating; pass if every measured level is at or below 53 dBµV/m.

text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions (LED modules)
test_case: Operate lamp with all functions (position, stop, reversing) energised at nominal supply during Annex 7 test; verify operating mode recorded in test report

text: As an alternative to an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) an open area test site (OATS), which complies with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4 may be used (see Figure 1 of the appendix to Annex 7).
applies_to: Whole lamp as ESA
test_case: If OATS used, verify site compliance with CISPR 16-1-4 and set-up per Annex 7 Appendix Figure 1

text: The broadband emission limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an ALSE or OATS.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB; whole lamp as ESA
test_case: Radiated emission scan 30-1,000 MHz in ALSE/OATS; pass if emissions below para 6.5 broadband ESA limits across the full range

text: Measurements can be performed with either quasi-peak or peak detectors; the limits given in paragraphs 6.5. and 7.10. are for quasi-peak detectors, and if peak detectors are used a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.
applies_to: Whole lamp as ESA
test_case: Verify detector type in report; if peak detector, check 20 dB correction applied to limits per CISPR 12

text: For purely broadband disturbances, the maximum frequency step size of the scanning receiver may be increased up to a value not greater than the bandwidth value; for emissions generated by brush commutator motors without an electronic control unit, the maximum step size may be increased up to five times the bandwidth.
applies_to: Whole lamp as ESA
test_case: Verify step size used does not exceed bandwidth (or 5 × bandwidth for brush commutator motors without ECU)

text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load, during the narrowband emission test.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions (LED driver electronics)
test_case: Annex 8 test with all lamp functions (position, stop, reversing) energised in normal operation at maximum load; pass if the operating state is documented as normal/maximum load.

text: As an alternative to an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE), an open area test site (OATS) which complies with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4 may be used (see Figure 1 of the appendix to Annex 7).
applies_to: ESA electronics
test_case: If OATS is used, verify site compliance with CISPR 16-1-4; pass if the site validation is available.

text: The narrowband emission limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an ALSE or OATS.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / ESA electronics
test_case: Radiated narrowband scan 30-1,000 MHz in ALSE/OATS; pass if the emissions are below the paragraph 6.6.2.1. limits across the whole range.

text: Narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
applies_to: ESA electronics
test_case: Check the receiver configuration; pass if the average detector is used.

text: ESAs may comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion, provided that the results cover the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of Annex 9: (a) absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2; (b) TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3; (c) bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4; (d) stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5; (e) reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11. Frequency range and general test conditions shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
applies_to: Rear lamp ESA (LED modules on PCB, connector)
test_case: Review the immunity test plan and reports: the chosen ISO 11452 methods together cover 20 to 6,000 MHz without gaps. Pass if there is no gap in coverage.

text: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions; LED modules on PCB
test_case: During the Annex 9 immunity test, energise the rear position, stop and reversing functions via the harness connector in normal operating mode. Pass if all functions are active throughout exposure.

text: If the ESA under test consists of more than one unit, the interconnecting cables should ideally be the wiring harnesses as intended for use in the vehicle; if these are not available, the length between the electronic control unit and the AN shall be as defined in the standard. All cables in the wiring harness should be terminated as realistically as possible and preferably with real loads and actuators.
applies_to: Vehicle wiring harness connection; multi-pin connector
test_case: Inspect the harness used in the test: use the vehicle harness, or a harness of the ISO 11452 length to the AN, with realistic terminations. Pass if it conforms.

text: ESA immunity measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
applies_to: Rear lamp ESA
test_case: Sweep 20–6,000 MHz with step sizes per ISO 11452-1. Pass if the lamp functions show no malfunction across the whole range.

text: The test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
applies_to: Rear lamp ESA
test_case: Verify the signal generator settings: AM at 1 kHz with 80 % depth for 20–400 MHz. Pass if the ESA is immune with these settings.

text: The test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
applies_to: Rear lamp ESA
test_case: Verify the generator settings: PM with Ton 3 µs and period 3,333 µs for 2,700–3,100 MHz. Pass if the ESA is immune.

text: The test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
applies_to: Rear lamp ESA
test_case: Verify the generator settings: PM with Ton 500 µs and period 1,000 µs for 380–2,700 MHz and 3,100–6,000 MHz. Pass if the ESA is immune.

text: As an alternative, the ESA may be tested while installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 with the BCI substitution method and the injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
applies_to: Rear lamp ESA installed on vehicle
test_case: Perform in-vehicle BCI per ISO 11451-4 with the probe at 150 mm from the lamp. Pass if there is no malfunction.

text: The ESA shall be immune to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply, as ensured by the test method of Annex 10.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB; connector to vehicle harness (rear position, stop and reversing lamp electronics)
test_case: Annex 10 transient immunity tests (paragraph 2): ESA functions as required with no unacceptable degradation of the lamp functions

text: Conducted transients from the ESA to the vehicle power supply shall be limited, as ensured by the test method of Annex 10.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB; connector to vehicle harness
test_case: Annex 10 transient emission measurement (paragraph 3): emitted transients within the specified limits

text: Test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the 12/24 V supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines, and the ESA shall be immune to these transient disturbances.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB; supply and signal connections of position, stop and reversing lamp functions
test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a, 3b applied to supply lines and connections operationally connected to them; pass: ESA meets its functional status requirements

text: The starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the 12/24 V supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines, and the ESA shall be immune to it; ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to the starting profile.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB; supply connections of the rear lamp
test_case: ISO 16750-2 starting profile applied to supply lines and operationally connected connections (unless ESA exclusively for electric vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor); pass: ESA meets its functional status requirements

text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
applies_to: Housing / outer lens (marking area)
test_case: Visual inspection of drawings and samples: a marking area exists that accommodates the approval marking and all markings of 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.

text: All markings on the device shall be clearly legible and indelible.
applies_to: All markings on lamp
test_case: Visual check of legibility; indelibility check (e.g. rubbing test with water/solvent-soaked cloth); markings remain legible.

text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for "a" shall be at least 5 mm.
applies_to: Approval marking
test_case: Measure dimension "a" of the approval mark per Annex 7 arrangement; pass if a ≥ 5 mm.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
applies_to: Approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection of marking: circle around "E" with distinguishing number of approving country present.

text: The approval marking shall include the four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2., and this sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
applies_to: Approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection: 4–6 digit sequential number present and located adjacent to the approval mark.

text: The approval marking shall include the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
applies_to: Approval marking (rear position, stop, reversing lamp symbols; retro-reflector)
test_case: Visual inspection: function symbols per 3.2.4 present for each approved function (e.g. R, S1, AR).

text: The approval marking shall include the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
applies_to: Approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection: "148R" followed by two-digit series of amendments present.

text: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall include a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
applies_to: Approval marking (handed lamp)
test_case: Check whether lamp is handed; if so, verify horizontal mounting arrow present on marking.

text: For front or rear position lamps and front or rear end-outline marker lamps which cannot be mounted on either side indiscriminately, the horizontal arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
applies_to: Rear position lamp marking
test_case: Visual inspection of fitted lamp/drawing: arrow points outboard of vehicle.

text: For reversing lamps in case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps, the horizontal arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
applies_to: Reversing lamp marking
test_case: Visual inspection: if reversing lamp approved with reduced distribution as a pair, arrow points outboard.

text: If applicable, the additional letter "D" shall be placed to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4. on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps.
applies_to: Approval marking (function symbols)
test_case: Visual inspection: "D" to the right of the function symbol where lamp is approved as part of two independent lamps.

text: If applicable, the additional letter "Y" shall be placed to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4. on lamps which are used as part of an interdependent lamps system.
applies_to: Approval marking (function symbols)
test_case: Visual inspection: "Y" to the right of the function symbol where lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system.

text: On lamps with reduced light distribution (see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3), the approval marking shall include a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
applies_to: Approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection: downward vertical arrow from horizontal segment present where reduced light distribution approved.

text: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp
test_case: Visual inspection of lamp sample: complete approval marking present.

text: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp
test_case: Visual inspection: applicant trade name or mark present on lamp.

text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with: (a) an electronic light source control gear; and/or (b) a variable luminous intensity control; and/or (c) a secondary operating mode; and/or (d) non-replaceable light sources.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp (LED modules, electronics)
test_case: Visual inspection: rated voltage (e.g. 12V) or voltage range marked on lamp when any of conditions (a)-(d) apply.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB (if replaceable)
test_case: Visual inspection of module: applicant trade name or mark present.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the specific identification code of the module, comprising the starting letters "MD" for "MODULE" followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1., followed by additional symbols or characters in case several non-identical light source modules are used; the approval mark does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp in which the module is used, but both marks shall be from the same applicant.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB (if replaceable)
test_case: Visual inspection: module code "MD" + approval mark without circle (+ distinguishing characters for non-identical modules); verify same applicant as lamp mark.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB (if replaceable)
test_case: Visual inspection: rated voltage or range marked on module.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp
test_case: Visual inspection: module identification code marked on lamp matches module.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp
test_case: Visual inspection: rated voltage or range marked on lamp.

text: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
applies_to: External control gear (if any)
test_case: Visual inspection of external control gear: identification number and manufacturer name present.

text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
applies_to: Housing / outer lens
test_case: Design review: marking located on a part permanently attached to the light-emitting outer lens.

text: The approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
applies_to: Approval marking location
test_case: Inspection on vehicle: marking visible as fitted or after opening boot lid/door/hood.

text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both the detachable lens and the main body.
applies_to: Outer lens, housing
test_case: If lens is detachable, verify approval marking on both lens and housing.

text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
applies_to: Outer lens, housing
test_case: Where lens is shared, verify each housing bears only its own function approval markings.

text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp
test_case: Visual inspection: listed markings located on the lamp itself.

text: The markings in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a) shall be affixed on the light source module component.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB (if replaceable)
test_case: Visual inspection: module markings located on the module.

text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number may be affixed anywhere on the lamps, provided that it is visible after their installation.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp (combined functions)
test_case: If single mark used: inspect on vehicle that mark is visible after installation.

text: Where a single approval mark is used on grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
applies_to: Outer lens, housing
test_case: Design review/disassembly: removal of any light-transmitting part also removes the approval mark.

text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
applies_to: Approval marking
test_case: Measure mark components; compare with minimum sizes in each applicable Regulation; pass if ≥ the smallest individual required size.

text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp function units of the rear combination lamp
test_case: Review the conformity assessment against every applicable requirement of paragraphs 4. and 5. of UN R148 for each lamp function submitted. Pass if all applicable requirements are met and none is unaddressed.

text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval, shall apply to the lamp; the requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where their verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, retro-reflector (installation-related specifications for M1)
test_case: At lamp type approval, identify the applicable sections 5 and 6 requirements of UN R48 (series in force) for each function (rear position, stop, reversing lamp, rear retro-reflector) and vehicle category M1. Verify the requirements that can be checked at lamp level, e.g. geometric visibility angles (reversing lamp to 45° outboard), colour and number of lamps, against the lamp design and installation drawings. Pass if all feasible-to-verify requirements are met.

text: The lamps shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp function units; housing, LED modules on PCB, fasteners/clips, seal, outer lens
test_case: Design verification: vibration test representative of vehicle use (e.g. per manufacturer/OEM vibration profile) on the complete rear combination lamp, followed by functional check and re-measurement of photometric and colorimetric characteristics; pass if all functions operate satisfactorily and still meet the R148 photometric and colour requirements.

text: An assembly of two independent lamps to be type approved as lamp marked "D" is applicable only to front and rear position lamps, stop lamps, front and rear end-outline marker lamps, daytime running lamps and direction indicator lamps.
applies_to: Rear position lamp and stop lamp function units (if approved as "D" assembly)
test_case: Document and marking review: confirm that any lamp function marked "D" is one of the listed functions (e.g. rear position or stop lamp), not the reversing lamp or retro-reflector. Pass if no "D" marking is applied to non-listed functions.

text: An interdependent lamp system to be type approved as lamps marked "Y" is applicable only to front and rear position lamps, stop lamps, front and rear end-outline marker lamps, daytime running lamps and direction indicator lamps.
applies_to: Rear position lamp and stop lamp function units (if approved as "Y" interdependent system)
test_case: Document and marking review: confirm that any lamp function marked "Y" is one of the listed functions (e.g. rear position or stop lamp), not the reversing lamp or retro-reflector. Pass if no "Y" marking is applied to non-listed functions.

text: Lamps having been approved as front or rear position lamps are deemed being also approved end-outline marker lamps.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit)
test_case: Document review: confirm rear position lamp approval; no separate end-outline marker approval needed for end-outline marker use.

text: Front and rear position lamps which are grouped or combined or reciprocally incorporated may also be used as end-outline marker lamps.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit)
test_case: Design review: if the grouped/combined/reciprocally incorporated rear position lamp is used as an end-outline marker lamp, confirm it meets the rear position lamp approval.

text: Position lamps or daytime running lamps which are reciprocally incorporated with another function, using a common light source, and designed to operate permanently with an additional system to regulate the intensity of the light emitted, are permitted.
applies_to: Rear position lamp / stop lamp; LED modules on PCB
test_case: Design and photometric review: where the rear position lamp shares an LED source with another function, verify the intensity regulation system operates permanently and photometry is met in each mode.

text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either (a) be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source); or (b) be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
applies_to: Rear position lamp and stop lamp; LED modules on PCB
test_case: Design review of LED circuit: verify separate light sources for rear position and stop functions, or verify the vehicle provides a failure tell-tale for the lamps; pass if one of the alternatives is met.

text: The internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside the apparent surface of a lamp (function) may incorporate only one manufacturer logo, built by transparent or non-transparent components, provided that all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation are fulfilled.
applies_to: Outer lens; Reflector; Rear position lamp
test_case: Visual inspection: count logos within the apparent surface (max one) and verify full photometric/colour compliance of the function with the logo present.

text: Irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer is allowed within the apparent surface of a lamp (function).
applies_to: Outer lens; Rear position lamp
test_case: Inspection of logo content and applicant statement per paragraph 3.1.2.2. (f); pass if logo is the vehicle or body manufacturer brand name only.

text: The enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
applies_to: Outer lens; Rear position lamp
test_case: Measure projected enclosed logo area in the direction of the reference axis; pass if ≤ 100 cm2.

text: Notwithstanding the requirements of paragraph 5.5.2. of UN Regulation No. 48, the logo light emitting surface (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) does not have to be symmetrical by itself.
applies_to: Outer lens; Rear position lamp
test_case: Design review: logo asymmetry accepted; verify remaining symmetry requirements of the lamp installation are met.

text: Stop lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit); Outer lens
test_case: Visual inspection of the stop lamp apparent surface and outer lens; pass if no logo is present.

text: Reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function unit); Outer lens
test_case: Visual inspection of the reversing lamp apparent surface and outer lens; pass if no logo is present.

text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB; rear position, stop and reversing lamp function units
test_case: Review of the circuit diagram and LED wiring (series strings) per function. Each group wired so that one LED failure extinguishes the whole group is treated as one light source in the failure assessment of paragraph 4.6.1.2.

text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply: (a) the light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3, and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or (b) a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced, in which case a note in the communication form states that the lamp is only for use on a vehicle fitted with a tell-tale indicating failure.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp function units; LED modules on PCB; connector
test_case: Option (a): simulate failure of each light source (or group per para 4.6.1.1) in turn. Measure on a goniophotometer at the Annex 3 standard light distribution points. Pass if every point is at or above the minimum, and if the maximum intensities are not exceeded with all light sources lit. Option (b): simulate each failure and verify that a tell-tale activation signal per the cited UN R48 paragraphs is output at the connector, and that the communication form carries the note.

text: The requirements of paragraph 4.6.1.2. (b) do not apply to stop- and position lamps for vehicles of category L; however, the requirements of paragraph 4.6.1.1. and paragraph 4.6.1.2. (a) are still applicable.
applies_to: Stop lamp and rear position lamp function units
test_case: If the lamp is approved for category L vehicles: verify that compliance with the failure provisions is shown by option (a) of para 4.6.1.2 (minimum intensities with any one light source failed, maximum intensities not exceeded with all lit), not by the tell-tale signal.

text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit); LED driver electronics
test_case: Applies if the position lamp is category R2. Simulate failure of the variable intensity control and measure the photometry. Pass if the lamp automatically reverts to the steady luminous intensity requirements of the respective category, with no emission above the R1 maximum.

text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a stop lamp category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit); LED driver electronics
test_case: Applies if the stop lamp is category S2. Simulate failure of the variable intensity control and measure the photometry. Pass if the steady luminous intensity requirements of the respective category are automatically met, with no emission above the S1 maximum.

text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a stop lamp category S4 emitting more than the maximum value of category S3, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit); LED driver electronics
test_case: Applies if the stop lamp is category S4. Simulate failure of the variable intensity control and measure the photometry. Pass if the steady luminous intensity requirements of the respective category are automatically met, with no emission above the S3 maximum.

text: The lamp shall only be equipped with: replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
applies_to: LED modules on PCB; rear position, stop and reversing lamp function units
test_case: Design review of the bill of materials and light source documentation: every light source is a UN R37/R99/R128 approved replaceable light source without use restriction, a light source module, or a non-replaceable light source; any other light source type is a fail.

text: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB; electrical connector; vehicle harness connection
test_case: EMC testing of radiated and conducted (power line) emissions at vehicle-type level, e.g. per UN R10. Pass if no malfunction of other vehicle electric/electronic systems is caused.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB (if replaceable light source modules); housing
test_case: Fitting test: attempt to install the module in alternative positions and orientations. Pass if it fits only in the designated and correct position.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
applies_to: LED modules on PCB (if replaceable light source modules); fasteners / clips
test_case: Removal test: attempt to remove the module by hand without tools. Pass if removal is possible only with tool(s).

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it is tamperproof.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB (if replaceable light source modules)
test_case: Inspection and tamper attempt on the module construction. Pass if it cannot be opened or modified without visible destruction.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that, regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB (if replaceable light source modules)
test_case: Interchangeability check: attempt to fit UN approved replaceable light sources in the module seat, with and without tools. Pass if none can be fitted.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that, regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB for rear position, stop and reversing functions (if replaceable modules)
test_case: Interchangeability check: attempt to swap modules of different characteristics between seats in the same housing, with and without tools. Pass if no swap is possible.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the device shall be met.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB (if replaceable light source modules); rear position, stop and reversing lamp photometry
test_case: Replace the module with another sample bearing the same identification code, then repeat the photometric measurements per UN R148. Pass if all photometric requirements are met.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
applies_to: LED modules; all lamp functions
test_case: Measure with steady (continuous) operation; verify that no flashing or pulsed mode is used unless specified.

text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp for testing shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
applies_to: Multi-pin connector; vehicle harness supply
test_case: Apply 13.5 V (12 V system) or the applicable value at the lamp terminals; verify the voltage during the photometric test.

text: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
applies_to: LED driver electronics on PCB
test_case: Operate the lamp per the applicant's specification with the control gear supplied if required; record the operating conditions.

text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB
test_case: Operate per the applicant's specified voltage or current; verify the conditions in the test report.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions
test_case: Annex 3/Annex 8: measure HV on both samples; pass if ≥ the paragraph 5. minimum.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions
test_case: Scan the full visible field on both samples; pass if no value exceeds the paragraph 5. maximum.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5. by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3 for each direction in question, or be not less than the intensity value specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions
test_case: Measure each Annex 3 grid point; pass if ≥ minimum × % (or ≥ the specified value).

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions
test_case: Measure at the Annex 2 geometric visibility angles (e.g. reversing lamp to 45° outboard); pass if ≥ the specified minimum.

text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions
test_case: Evaluate the local intensity variations per Annex 3 criteria.

text: In order to verify the visibility of red light towards the front and/or white light towards the rear of a vehicle required in UN Regulation No. 48, the applicant may request an additional test to show that in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction the maximum intensity is not more than 2.5∙10-1 cd; this additional test may be conducted taking into account the influence of the vehicle body.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (red); reversing lamp (white)
test_case: Optional test: measure over H 165°–180° outboard and V -2.5° to +5°; pass if max ≤ 0.25 cd.

text: The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities outside the range specified in paragraph 5.
applies_to: Variable intensity control (stop/rear position lamp electronics)
test_case: Drive the control through all states; pass if the intensities stay within the paragraph 5. range.

text: The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities exceeding the respective steady luminous intensity maximum specified in paragraph 5. for the specific lamp: (a) for systems depending only on daytime and night-time conditions, under night-time conditions; (b) for other systems, under standard conditions (good visibility, MOR > 2,000 m, and clean lens).
applies_to: Variable intensity control
test_case: Set the night-time or standard condition; pass if the measured intensity is ≤ the steady maximum.

text: If a rear position lamp and/or a rear end-outline marker lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously and the intensity of the rear position lamp or end-outline marker lamp when turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table; if one or both of the two reciprocally incorporated lamps contain(s) more than one light source and is (are) considered as a single lamp, the values to be considered are those obtained with all sources in operation.
applies_to: Rear position lamp; stop lamp
test_case: Measure stop+position and position alone over ±5° V / ±10° H; pass if the ratio is ≥ 5:1 at each point.

text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in Annex 3, no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
applies_to: Outer lens; rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions
test_case: Visual/colorimetric inspection of emitted light outside the Annex 3 grid field for each function; pass if no sharp colour variation is observed.

text: For lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB (non-replaceable light sources) for rear position, stop and reversing functions
test_case: Colorimetric verification of the complete lamp with its built-in LED modules operated per relevant subparagraphs of 4.8; chromaticity within the function's colour limits.

text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of rear position lamps (R1, R2, MR) and rear end-outline marker lamps (RM1, RM2) shall meet the requirements in Table 4.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit)
test_case: Photometric measurement of both samples per paragraph 4.8.3.1. and Annex 3 Figure A3-I / Table A2-1; pass if all Table 4 values are met by each sample.

text: Rear position lamps of category R1 or MR, and rear end-outline marker lamps of category RM1 (steady), shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 4∙10^0 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), with the standard light distribution defined by Figure A3-I and Table A2-1 (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)).
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement on axis and at the Figure A3-I / Table A2-1 grid points; pass if the minimum is >= 4 cd and the distribution percentages are met.

text: Rear position lamps of category R1 or MR, and rear end-outline marker lamps of category RM1 (steady), shall not exceed a maximum luminous intensity of 1.7∙10^1 cd when used as a single lamp (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)).
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement over the distribution field; pass if the maximum is <= 17 cd.

text: Rear position lamps of category R1 or MR, and rear end-outline marker lamps of category RM1 (steady), shall not exceed a maximum luminous intensity of 8.5∙10^0 cd for a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2., Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)).
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement of the lamp marked "D"; pass if the maximum is <= 8.5 cd.

text: Rear position lamps of category R1 or MR, and rear end-outline marker lamps of category RM1 (steady), shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 5∙10^-2 cd within the angles of geometric visibility (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)).
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit)
test_case: Measurement at the boundaries and within the angles of geometric visibility; pass if every value is >= 0.05 cd.

text: Rear position lamps of category R2 and rear end-outline marker lamps of category RM2 (variable) shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 4∙10^0 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), with the standard light distribution defined by Figure A3-I and Table A2-1 (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)).
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement in all variable intensity modes; pass if the minimum is >= 4 cd and the distribution per Figure A3-I / Table A2-1 is met.

text: Rear position lamps of category R2 and rear end-outline marker lamps of category RM2 (variable) shall not exceed a maximum luminous intensity of 4.2∙10^1 cd when used as a single lamp (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)).
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement in all variable modes; pass if the maximum is <= 42 cd.

text: Rear position lamps of category R2 and rear end-outline marker lamps of category RM2 (variable) shall not exceed a maximum luminous intensity of 2.1∙10^1 cd for a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2., Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)).
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement of the lamp marked "D"; pass if the maximum is <= 21 cd.

text: Rear position lamps of category R2 and rear end-outline marker lamps of category RM2 (variable) shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 5∙10^-2 cd within the angles of geometric visibility (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)).
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit)
test_case: Measurement within the angles of geometric visibility; pass if every value is >= 0.05 cd.

text: For rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps, a luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd shall be permitted below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit); Stop lamp (function unit)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement of the rear position function below 5° down from horizontal; pass if the intensity is <= 60 cd there and the Table 4 maximum is met elsewhere.

text: The colour of light emitted by rear position lamps (R1, R2, MR) and rear end-outline marker lamps (RM1, RM2) shall be red.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit); Outer lens
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the emitted light; pass if the chromaticity coordinates are within the red boundaries of the colour definition referenced by the Regulation.

text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of stop lamp supplied shall meet the luminous intensity and standard light distribution requirements in Table 7 for its category (S1, S2, S3, S4, MS).
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit)
test_case: Photometric goniometer measurement of both samples per paragraph 4.8.3.1; pass if all Table 7 values for the declared category are met on each sample.

text: A category S1 (steady) stop lamp shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 6.0·10^1 cd (paragraph 4.8.3.1.(a)).
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit)
test_case: Photometric measurement on reference axis per paragraph 4.8.3.1.(a); pass if ≥ 60 cd on both samples.

text: A category S1 (steady) stop lamp shall not exceed a maximum luminous intensity of 2.60·10^2 cd when used as a single lamp, or 1.30·10^2 cd for a lamp marked "D" (paragraph 3.3.2.5.2.) (paragraph 4.8.3.1.(b)).
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit)
test_case: Photometric measurement over the distribution per paragraph 4.8.3.1.(b); pass if max ≤ 260 cd (single) or ≤ 130 cd (marked D).

text: A category S1 (steady) stop lamp shall meet the standard light distribution defined in Table A2-1 (paragraph 4.8.3.1.(c)).
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit)
test_case: Measure luminous intensity at the Table A2-1 grid points per paragraph 4.8.3.1.(c); pass if all point values are met.

text: A category S1 (steady) stop lamp shall provide a minimum luminous intensity of 3·10^-1 cd within the angles of geometric visibility of Figure A3-I (paragraph 4.8.3.1.(d)).
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit)
test_case: Measure over the Figure A3-I geometric visibility field per paragraph 4.8.3.1.(d); pass if ≥ 0.3 cd everywhere.

text: A category S2 (variable) stop lamp shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 6.0·10^1 cd (paragraph 4.8.3.1.(a)).
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit)
test_case: Photometric measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1.(a); pass if ≥ 60 cd on both samples.

text: A category S2 (variable) stop lamp shall not exceed a maximum luminous intensity of 7.30·10^2 cd when used as a single lamp, or 3.65·10^2 cd for a lamp marked "D" (paragraph 3.3.2.5.2.) (paragraph 4.8.3.1.(b)).
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit)
test_case: Photometric measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1.(b); pass if max ≤ 730 cd (single) or ≤ 365 cd (marked D).

text: A category S2 (variable) stop lamp shall meet the standard light distribution defined in Table A2-1 (paragraph 4.8.3.1.(c)).
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit)
test_case: Measure at Table A2-1 grid points per paragraph 4.8.3.1.(c); pass if all point values are met.

text: A category S2 (variable) stop lamp shall provide a minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility of Figure A3-I of 3·10^-1 cd (day) and 7·10^-2 cd (night) (paragraph 4.8.3.1.(d)).
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit)
test_case: Measure over the Figure A3-I field in day and night modes per paragraph 4.8.3.1.(d); pass if ≥ 0.3 cd (day) and ≥ 0.07 cd (night).

text: The colour of light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit); Outer lens
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light through the outer lens; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the red boundaries of the regulation.

text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of reversing lamp (AR) supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10: minimum luminous intensity 8.0∙10^1 cd (par. 4.8.3.1.(a)) according to the standard light distribution of Figure A3-V (par. 4.8.3.1.(c)).
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function unit)
test_case: Photometric measurement on both samples per par. 4.8.3.1. and Figure A3-V; all grid points meet minimum 80 cd scaled per standard light distribution.

text: The maximum luminous intensity of the reversing lamp (AR) shall not exceed 3.00∙10^2 cd in or above the h-plane.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function unit)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement on both samples in or above H-plane; max intensity ≤ 300 cd.

text: The maximum luminous intensity of the reversing lamp (AR) shall not exceed 6.00∙10^2 cd below the h-plane, down to 5°D.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function unit)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement on both samples between H and 5°D; max intensity ≤ 600 cd.

text: The maximum luminous intensity of the reversing lamp (AR) shall not exceed 8.00∙10^3 cd below 5°D.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function unit)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement on both samples below 5°D; max intensity ≤ 8000 cd.

text: In the case where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards, where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙10^1 cd shall be satisfied; the device shall then only be installed in a pair.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function unit)
test_case: If pair-only approval claimed: photometric measurement up to 30° inwards; intensity at 30° inwards ≥ 25 cd; verify vehicle installation is in pairs.

text: The failure provisions of paragraph 4.6. shall apply to the reversing lamp.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function unit); LED modules on PCB
test_case: Verify compliance with par. 4.6 failure provisions (e.g., LED failure simulation) for the reversing function.

text: The colour of light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function unit); Outer lens
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light; chromaticity coordinates within white boundaries defined by the regulation.

text: Lamps shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved under this Regulation.
applies_to: Whole rear combination lamp (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions)
test_case: Conformity of production check: compare production samples with the approved type (drawings, photometry, colour, markings); pass if no deviation from the approved type.

text: For conformity of production, no measured value shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in this Regulation.
applies_to: Photometric performance of rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions
test_case: Photometric measurement of production samples at the prescribed test points per Annex 2/3; pass if each measured value deviates unfavourably by no more than 20 % from the prescribed value.

text: For the minimum values required throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, the measured values shall correspond to the values shown in Table 12: required minimum 7∙10-1 cd → 5∙10-1 cd (20 per cent) / 3∙10-1 cd (30 per cent); 6∙10-1 cd → 4∙10-1 cd / 2∙10-1 cd; 3∙10-1 cd → 2∙10-1 cd / 1∙10-1 cd; 7∙10-2 cd → 5∙10-2 cd / 3∙10-2 cd; 5∙10-2 cd → 3∙10-2 cd / 2∙10-2 cd.
applies_to: Photometric minimum values throughout the light distribution fields of rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions
test_case: Measure luminous intensity throughout the fields of Annexes 2 and 3 on production samples; pass if measured values are not below the Table 12 equivalent 20 per cent (or 30 per cent where applicable under Annex 5) values.

text: The angles of geometric visibility shown in Annex 2 are correct for lamps to be mounted on the right side of the vehicle; for lamps mounted on the left side the angles shall be applied mirror-symmetrically (inboard/outboard interchanged).
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp (handedness of the rear combination lamp)
