text: For an interdependent lamp system partly mounted on the fixed component and partly on a movable component (other than direction indicator lamps), the inwards geometric visibility requirement(s) is(are) deemed to be satisfied if the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant still conform(s) to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit); inward geometric visibility; photometry
test_case: Photometric measurement of the specified interdependent lamp(s) over the device-approval light distribution field at each fixed position of the movable component. Pass: prescribed photometric values met at all fixed positions.

text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp (rear position, stop, reversing lamps and retro-reflector) where installed on a movable component (e.g. tailgate/boot lid)
test_case: Installation inspection per UN R48 para. 5.19: place the movable component (e.g. tailgate) in each position other than the normal position of use, with the lamp functions activated; verify that no device installed on it causes undue discomfort (e.g. glare or misleading signals) to road users. Pass if no undue discomfort is found in any such position.

text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp installation (rear position, stop, reversing lamps and retro-reflector) if mounted on a movable component such as a tailgate or boot lid
test_case: Installation check per UN R48: with the lamp on the movable component, move the component out of and back into the normal position(s) of use several times. After each return, measure the lamp position and orientation (mounting height, lateral position, geometric visibility angles) and compare them with the manufacturer's specified position(s). Pass if the lamp returns to the specified position(s) every time and the R48 installation requirements are still met.

text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use"; fixed position of a movable component means the stable or natural rest position(s) of the movable component specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit); Retro-reflector; installation on vehicle
test_case: Vehicle inspection: place each movable component (e.g. tailgate, boot lid) in every manufacturer-specified stable or natural rest position other than normal position of use; measure the apparent surface of the rear position lamp and retro-reflector in the direction of the reference axis; pass if no more than 50 per cent is hidden, otherwise para. 5.21.1 or 5.21.2 compliance must be shown.

text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21 is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit); Retro-reflector; installation on vehicle
test_case: Vehicle test: move the movable component to each position where more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface is hidden; verify the additional lamps switch ON automatically and verify their position, geometric visibility, colour and photometry against the requirements for the lamp replaced; pass if all are met.

text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21 is not practicable and additional lamps per paragraph 5.21.1 are not used, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road, for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road; this alternative (paragraph 5.21.2) does not apply to retro-reflectors.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit); installation on vehicle (user notice)
test_case: Vehicle inspection: where more than 50 per cent of the rear position lamp apparent surface can be hidden and no additional lamps are fitted, verify presence and content of the user notice in the vehicle and the remark in item 10.1 of the Annex 1 communication form; verify that for retro-reflectors this alternative is not used (compliance with 5.21 or 5.21.1 required).

text: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp, even bearing an approval mark, is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse; each lamp function shall therefore be capable of being made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp function units; LED modules on PCB; connector/vehicle harness connection
test_case: Inspection of the vehicle installation and electrical schematic: with the light source(s) and fuse(s) fitted, activate each lamp function (rear position, stop, reversing) via its vehicle control; pass if each lamp operates without any further wiring, connector or component additions. Lamps not operable in this way are treated as not present.

text: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed only provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate.
applies_to: rear position lamp; stop lamp (as potential replacement device); LED modules on PCB
test_case: Simulate failure of the rear position lamp function; verify the replacement function emits light of the same colour (red, colorimetric check), similar main intensity (photometric measurement against rear position lamp values) and from a similar position (mounting geometry check).

text: Where a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is provided, the replacement device shall remain operational in its original safety function.
applies_to: stop lamp; rear position lamp; LED modules on PCB
test_case: With the rear position lamp function failed and the replacement active, activate the replacement device's original function (e.g. stop lamp); verify it operates and meets its photometric requirements.

text: During temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
applies_to: vehicle wiring harness connection; electronics (failure detection/communication)
test_case: Vehicle-level test: induce rear position lamp failure; verify the dashboard tell-tale illuminates for the whole duration of the replacement indicating temporary replacement and need for repair.

text: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., are allowed provided that the intensity of all these lamps, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (R2), stop lamp (S2), LED modules / intensity control
test_case: Activate each variable-intensity trigger condition and measure luminous intensity of all combined/grouped/reciprocally incorporated R2, S2 and 2b lamps over the variation; pass if all vary simultaneously, in the same manner and in similar proportion.

text: For rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, in the entire intensity range the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (R2), stop lamp (S2), intensity control
test_case: Photometric measurement of the paired lamps (e.g. stop/position ratio) at multiple points throughout the intensity range and during transitions; pass if the prescribed ratio is maintained at all points.

text: Increase and decrease of the luminous intensity of variable-intensity lamps, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed only in relation to the following environmental conditions: (a) ambient lighting, (b) fog, (c) snowfall, (d) rain, (e) spray, (f) dust clouds, (g) contamination of the light emitting surface.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, intensity control
test_case: Review control strategy and simulate each environmental condition; pass if intensity changes only in response to listed conditions and remains within the limits of the pertinent UN Regulation (e.g. R148) at all levels.

text: Independent from the environmental conditions of paragraph 5.26.1., a decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m; however, as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h, the intensity decrease already activated may remain active.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, intensity control
test_case: Vehicle-level test varying speed and following distance: verify decrease activates only at ≤20 km/h or ≤20 m, may persist up to ≤50 km/h, and is cancelled above 50 km/h when not otherwise justified; reduced intensity within regulation photometric limits.

text: Stop lamps of category S4 and rear fog lamps of category F2 may produce variable luminous intensity, based on the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., independently from the other lamps.
applies_to: Stop lamp (if category S4)
test_case: Check lamp category on approval documentation; if S4, verify independent variation responds only to conditions of 5.26.1/5.26.2 and stays within photometric limits.

text: No sharp variation of intensity of variable-intensity lamps shall be observed during transition.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, LED driver / intensity control
test_case: Record luminous intensity versus time during each transition with a photometer; pass if the change is gradual with no observable step or abrupt jump.

text: It may be possible for the driver to set the variable luminous intensity functions to static luminous intensities.
applies_to: Intensity control, vehicle harness / control interface
test_case: If provided, verify the driver control sets the lamps to static intensity and that the static intensity is within the prescribed photometric limits.

text: For vehicles of M and N categories, the electric power supply conditions for the devices indicated in 2.5.1., 2.5.2., 2.5.4., 2.5.6. and 2.5.7. shall comply with the provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. to 5.27.3. when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp power supply; vehicle wiring harness connection
test_case: Demonstrate to the Technical Service with the vehicle electrical system in a constant voltage operating condition representative of the vehicle category; pass if the terminal voltages meet 5.27.1/5.27.2 or the device is exempt under 5.27.3.

text: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB; connector to vehicle harness; rear position, stop and reversing functions
test_case: Measure voltage at the lamp terminals under constant voltage operating condition; pass if it does not exceed the voltage stated in the device's type approval documentation.

text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V by more than 3 per cent for 6 Volt-Systems.
applies_to: Lamp terminals / connector (6 V systems)
test_case: Measure terminal voltage under constant voltage operating condition; pass if ≤ 6.75 V + 3 %.

text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 13.5 V by more than 3 per cent for 12 Volt-Systems.
applies_to: Lamp terminals / connector (12 V systems)
test_case: Measure terminal voltage under constant voltage operating condition; pass if ≤ 13.5 V + 3 %.

text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 28 V by more than 3 per cent for 24 Volt-Systems.
applies_to: Lamp terminals / connector (24 V systems)
test_case: Measure terminal voltage under constant voltage operating condition; pass if ≤ 28 V + 3 %.

text: The means of controlling the maximum voltage at the terminals of the device may, for convenience, be located within the body of the device.
applies_to: PCB / housing (voltage control means)
test_case: Inspection of design: where the voltage limiting means is integrated in the lamp body, verify terminal-voltage compliance is still demonstrated.

text: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to devices which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB; electronic light source control gear; rear position, stop and reversing functions
test_case: Review of device design and approval documentation; exemption applies if the lamp contains electronic light source control gear, an integrated variable intensity control, or only UN R128 approved light sources.

text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity. However, no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, retro-reflector; installation at vehicle rear
test_case: Installation inspection: check each function's apparent surface across its prescribed geometric visibility angles, observed from infinity, for obstruction by vehicle parts. Obstacles already present at lamp type-approval are disregarded. Pass if no obstruction is found.

text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, retro-reflector; outer lens; installed on vehicle
test_case: Photometric measurement of the installed lamp with the vehicle obstruction present, or simulated by masking. Pass if the unobstructed part meets the photometric values prescribed in the device approval regulation for each function.

text: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5° (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5° below the horizontal.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, retro-reflector; mounting height
test_case: Measure the mounting height per paragraph 5.8.1. If it is below 750 mm and the regulation permits a 5° reduction, the photometric field may be limited to 5° below horizontal. Pass if photometry is met within the applicable field.

text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, if realised as interdependent lamp systems
test_case: Operate all interdependent lamps of the system together and verify geometric visibility over the prescribed angles. Pass if the visibility requirements are met by the combined system.

text: A LED module does not need to be replaceable, if so stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB (light source for rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions)
test_case: Document review: check the component type approval communication sheet of the rear combination lamp. Pass if the LED modules are replaceable, or if the sheet explicitly states that the LED module is non-replaceable.

text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector function units of the rear combination lamp
test_case: Document review: for each function (rear position, stop, reversing lamp, retro-reflector), verify a valid type approval and approval marking according to the device Regulation specified in the relevant subparagraph of paragraph 6 of UN R48 (e.g. UN R148 for signalling lamps, UN R150 for retro-reflectors, as referenced). Pass if every function installed on the vehicle is covered by a valid approval.

text: Especially in case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of UN Regulation No. 148.
applies_to: Light-signalling functions (rear position lamp, stop lamp) and outer lens, if a manufacturer logo is incorporated
test_case: Inspect the lamp and drawings for an incorporated manufacturer logo; if present, verify that the lamp holds a type approval according to UN Regulation No. 148 covering the logo-incorporating configuration. Pass if the approval exists and the approval mark is present on the lamp.

text: The reversing lamp shall be present on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4; it is optional on trailers of category O1.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function unit)
test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify at least one reversing lamp function is fitted on the M1 vehicle; pass if present.

text: One reversing lamp device is mandatory and a second device optional on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function unit)
test_case: Vehicle inspection: count reversing lamp devices; pass if 1 or 2 devices are fitted.

text: Reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function unit); Outer lens; LED modules on PCB
test_case: Document and marking check: verify valid R23 or R148 (00 or later series) approval and corresponding approval mark on the lamp; pass if present.

text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in height not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground; for category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function unit); Housing; mounting on vehicle
test_case: Measure height of the illuminating surface above ground on the vehicle in unladen condition; pass if 250 mm ≤ height ≤ 1,200 mm (1,400 mm max for N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G).

text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle; however, if installed, the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. may be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. are fulfilled.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function unit); mounting on vehicle
test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the reversing lamp is installed at the rear of the vehicle; pass if rear-mounted.

text: The geometric visibility of reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, defined by angle α as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function unit); Outer lens; Housing
test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7. on installed lamp: verify unobstructed apparent surface from 15° up to 5° down; pass if visible over full range.

text: The geometric visibility of a reversing lamp installed at the rear of the vehicle, defined by angle β as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function unit); Outer lens; Housing
test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7. with a single reversing lamp: verify unobstructed visibility 45° left and 45° right; pass if visible over full range.

text: The geometric visibility of reversing lamps installed at the rear of the vehicle, defined by angle β as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be β = 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two devices.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function unit); Outer lens; Housing
test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7. with two reversing lamps: verify unobstructed visibility 45° outwards and 30° inwards for each lamp; pass if visible over full range.

text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function unit); Housing; mounting on vehicle
test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the reference axis of the reversing lamp is directed rearwards; pass if oriented rearwards.

text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function unit); connector; vehicle wiring harness
test_case: Functional test on vehicle: engage reverse with propulsion system operable; pass if lamp switches ON only under both conditions.

text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in a position where operation of the propulsion system is possible.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function unit); connector; vehicle wiring harness
test_case: Functional test on vehicle: disengage reverse, and separately switch propulsion system off with reverse engaged; pass if lamp does not switch ON or switches OFF in each case.

text: A tell-tale for the reversing lamp is optional; however, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function unit); LED modules on PCB; vehicle wiring harness
test_case: Check R23/R148 approval for failure-indication requirements; if required, simulate LED failure and verify the failure tell-tale activates.

text: Stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories are mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit)
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify S1 or S2 category stop lamps are fitted; pass if present.

text: The number of stop lamps shall be two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit)
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: count stop lamp devices by category; pass if two S1/S2 devices (left and right rear combination lamps) and one S3/S4 device are fitted.

text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit); Outer lens; LED modules on PCB
test_case: Document and marking check: verify approval mark and certificate to UN R7 02+ series or UN R148 00+ series for the stop function category S1/S2; pass if valid approval exists.

text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, for S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices, the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; for the distance in between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes there is no special requirement.
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit); Housing; mounting position
test_case: Measure on vehicle the lateral distance from outermost point of stop lamp apparent surface (in reference axis direction) to extreme outer edge of vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

text: S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be mounted above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit); mounting position
test_case: Measure height of apparent surface above ground per paragraph 5.8.1 on unladen vehicle; pass if lower edge ≥ 350 mm and upper edge ≤ 1,500 mm (or ≤ 2,100 mm where bodywork justifies and no optional lamps).

text: If the optional S1 or S2 category stop lamps are installed, they shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit); mounting position
test_case: Where optional stop lamps are fitted, measure vertical distance to mandatory stop lamps; pass if ≥ 600 mm and width/symmetry requirements met.

text: The horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the apparent surface of a S3 or S4 category stop lamp device shall be above the horizontal plane tangential to the upper edge of the apparent surface of S1 or S2 categories devices.
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit); mounting position relative to high-mounted stop lamp
test_case: Measure on vehicle the upper edge height of S1/S2 apparent surface and lower edge height of S3/S4 apparent surface; pass if S3/S4 lower edge is higher.

text: S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit); mounting position
test_case: Vehicle inspection: pass if stop lamps are located at the rear of the vehicle.

text: The geometric visibility of S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be, in the horizontal angle, 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle; however, for stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit); Outer lens; Housing
test_case: Geometric visibility check of apparent surface on vehicle: verify unobstructed view over 45° outboard and 45° inboard (or 20° inboard below H plane if mounted below 750 mm); pass if visibility requirements met.

text: The geometric visibility of S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be, in the vertical angle, 15° above and below the horizontal; however, (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit); Outer lens; Housing
test_case: Geometric visibility check on vehicle: verify unobstructed view 15° up and 15° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm; 5° up for optional lamp above 2,100 mm); pass if met.

text: The stop lamps shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit); Housing; Fasteners / clips
test_case: Installation inspection: verify reference axis of stop lamp points rearward; pass if oriented towards the rear.

text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit); LED modules on PCB; connector / vehicle wiring harness
test_case: Functional test on vehicle: apply brake signal per UN R13/R13-H; pass if all stop lamps illuminate simultaneously.

text: The stop lamps need not function if the device which starts and/or stops the propulsion system is in a position that makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate.
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit); vehicle wiring harness connection
test_case: Functional check with propulsion start/stop device in off position: stop lamp operation is permitted but not required; pass in either state.

text: A tell-tale for the stop lamps is optional; however, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
applies_to: Stop lamp (function unit); LED modules on PCB; connector / vehicle wiring harness
test_case: Check component approval (UN R7/R148) for failure tell-tale requirement; if required, simulate stop lamp failure and verify tell-tale indication; pass if provided where required.

text: Rear position lamps of the R or R1 or R2 categories shall be mandatorily installed on the vehicle.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit)
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are fitted; pass if present.

text: The number of rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit)
test_case: Inspect vehicle and approval markings: pass if exactly two mandatory rear position lamps are fitted, each bearing a valid R7 (02 series or later) or R148 (00 series or later) approval.

text: In width, the point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; this condition shall not apply to the optional rear lamps.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit); Housing mounting position
test_case: Measure on vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the apparent surface (reference axis direction) to the vehicle extreme outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

text: The distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear position lamps in the direction of the reference axes shall have no special requirement for M1 and N1 category vehicles; for all other categories of vehicles it shall be not less than 600 mm, which may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit); Housing mounting position
test_case: For M1/N1: no check required. For other categories: measure distance between inner edges of the apparent surfaces; pass if ≥ 600 mm (≥ 400 mm if overall width < 1,300 mm).

text: In height, the rear position lamps shall be mounted above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit); Housing mounting position
test_case: Measure height of apparent surface above ground per para. 5.8.1 with vehicle unladen; pass if 350 mm ≤ h ≤ 1,500 mm (or ≤ 2,100 mm where bodywork justifies and no optional lamps fitted).

text: If the optional rear position lamps are installed, they shall be placed at a height compatible with the applicable requirements of paragraph 6.10.4.1., the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit)
test_case: Where optional lamps fitted: measure vertical distance between optional and mandatory lamps; pass if ≥ 600 mm and lateral position complies with 6.10.4.1 and lamps are symmetrical.

text: In length, the rear position lamps shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit); Housing mounting position
test_case: Visual inspection of installation: pass if lamps are located at the rear of the vehicle.

text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be, in the horizontal angle, 45° inwards and 80° outwards; however, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit); Outer lens; Housing
test_case: Geometric visibility check on vehicle: verify unobstructed view of apparent surface over 45° inboard to 80° outboard (20° inboard below H plane if mounted < 750 mm); pass if visible throughout.

text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be, in the vertical angle, 15° above and below the horizontal; however, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.) the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°, and where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit); Outer lens; Housing
test_case: Geometric visibility check on vehicle: verify unobstructed view over 15° up and 15° down (5° down if mounted < 750 mm; 5° up for optional lamp > 2,100 mm); pass if visible throughout.

text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be 45° outwards to 45° inwards; however, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit); Outer lens; Housing
test_case: If alternative used: confirm rear side-marker lamp fitted; verify visibility 45° inboard to 45° outboard (20° inboard below H plane if mounted < 750 mm); pass if visible throughout.

text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles using the alternative of paragraph 6.10.5.2., the vertical angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be 15° above and below the horizontal; however, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit); Outer lens; Housing
test_case: If alternative used: verify visibility over 15° up and down (5° down if mounted < 750 mm); pass if visible throughout.

text: To be considered visible under paragraph 6.10.5.2., the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres; the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit); Outer lens; Retro-reflector
test_case: At each boundary direction of the alternative visibility field, measure unobstructed projected apparent surface excluding non-transmitting retro-reflector area; pass if ≥ 12.5 cm².

text: The orientation of the rear position lamps shall be rearwards.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function unit); Housing mounting
test_case: Inspect installation: pass if reference axis of the lamp is directed rearwards.

text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamps shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11; however, if a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator, the electrical connection of the rear position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB; Connector; Vehicle wiring harness connection
test_case: Functional electrical test on vehicle: verify switching per para. 5.11 (with front position lamps, end-outline and registration plate lamps as applicable); if reciprocally incorporated with direction indicator, verify any switch-off covers whole indicator operation only.

text: A closed-circuit tell-tale shall be mandatory for the rear position lamps and shall be combined with that of the front position lamps; this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON. However, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
applies_to: Vehicle wiring harness connection; Rear position lamp (function unit)
test_case: Switch on position lamps and check instrument cluster: pass if combined front/rear position closed-circuit tell-tale illuminates (not required while DRL on); verify failure tell-tale where component regulation requires.

text: Rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be mandatory on motor vehicles; provided that they are grouped together with the other rear light-signalling devices, they are optional on trailers.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify presence of rear non-triangular retro-reflectors on the M1 vehicle; pass if fitted.

text: The number of rear non-triangular retro-reflectors shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Check that two rear retro-reflectors are fitted and carry valid Class IA or IB approval marks per UN R3 (02 series or later) or UN R150 (00 series or later); pass if both comply.

text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4.) are permitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
applies_to: Retro-reflector; Outer lens
test_case: Inspection of any additional retro-reflecting devices/materials; pass if mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices' effectiveness is not impaired.

text: In width, the point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
applies_to: Retro-reflector; Housing (mounting position)
test_case: Measure lateral distance from outermost point of illuminating surface to extreme outer edge of vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

text: The distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear retro-reflectors in the direction of the reference axes shall have no special requirement for M1 and N1 category vehicles; for all other categories of vehicles it shall be not less than 600 mm, which may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Measure distance between inner edges of apparent surfaces of the two retro-reflectors; for M1/N1 no limit; other categories pass if ≥ 600 mm (≥ 400 mm if overall width < 1,300 mm).

text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively).
applies_to: Retro-reflector; Housing (mounting position)
test_case: Measure height of illuminating surface above ground with vehicle unladen per para 5.8.1; pass if 250 mm ≤ h ≤ 900 mm, or ≤ 1,200 mm when grouped with rear lamps, or ≤ 1,500 mm where bodywork shape prevents compliance.

text: In length, the rear retro-reflector shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
applies_to: Retro-reflector; Housing (mounting position)
test_case: Vehicle inspection; pass if retro-reflector is located at the rear of the vehicle.

text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall be: horizontal angle 30° inwards and outwards.
applies_to: Retro-reflector; Outer lens; Housing
test_case: Verify unobstructed visibility of the illuminating surface over 30° inwards and 30° outwards from the reference axis; pass if no obstruction.

text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall be: vertical angle 10° above and below horizontal; however, where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
applies_to: Retro-reflector; Outer lens; Housing
test_case: Verify unobstructed visibility over 10° up and 10° down (5° down if mounting height < 750 mm per 5.8.1); pass if no obstruction.

text: The orientation of the rear retro-reflector shall be rearwards.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Inspection of installed lamp; pass if retro-reflector reference axis faces rearwards.

text: The illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector may have parts in common with the apparent surface of any other lamp situated at the rear.
applies_to: Retro-reflector; Rear position lamp; Stop lamp; Reversing lamp; Outer lens
test_case: Design review: shared surfaces between retro-reflector and other rear lamp functions permitted; no fail criterion.

text: For the verification of paragraph 5.10.4. (no red light visible to the front and no white light visible to the rear), zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground, and in width by two vertical planes which, forming to the front and to the rear respectively an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, pass through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width; if there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost to the rearward plane.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, retro-reflector and outer lens (red light to the front / white light to the rear) as installed on the vehicle
test_case: Vehicle installation check per Annex 4: vehicle on substantially horizontal ground, lamps switched on. Observe from zone 1 (front) and zone 2 (rear), bounded by heights of 1 m to 2.2 m above ground and by vertical planes at 15° outwards from the median longitudinal plane through the overall-width contact points. Pass: no red light from the rear combination lamp is directly visible from zone 1, and no white light other than that permitted by paragraph 5.10 (e.g. the reversing lamp) is directly visible from zone 2.
